answer: Each new identity must escrow a slashable bond and keep proving it occupies an independent network path. Every epoch the ledger posts a nonce; the agent returns a keyed cipher over that nonce plus round-trip timings from at least two cables that cross the ocean and one isolated tundra observatory hop. Identities whose delay signatures are statistically interchangeable collapse into a single voting seat, and surplus bonds are slashed. Cloning accounts therefore inherits the same path fingerprint and cannot multiply influence.
